basis: Congenital hereditary ptosis affects the eyelids.
MYBPC3-associated myocardial noncompaction; documented in 6/6 patients.
Inherited abnormal proinsulin processing is an endocrine disorder; no other organ damage established.
Infection and inflammation of the external ear and auditory canal.
Familial neonatal epilepsy affects brain function.
Hypomyelination, cerebellar atrophy and corpus callosum hypoplasia define CNS disease; other POLR3-associated features are not established here.
Autoinflammation with panniculitis; myositis/contractures and hemolytic anemia each 1/1. Neurologic abnormalities omitted at the four-axis cap.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy; fixed foot deformities include pes cavus 6/6 and hammertoes 4/4. Reported type 2 diabetes is a separate disease.
Tumor originates in uterine or other reproductive tract stroma, outside the organ axes.
Primary malignant liver tumor. Portal vein thrombosis is a separately diagnosed complication; direct vascular tumor occupation is not established.
CRYBB3-associated nonsyndromic cataract affects the lens.
Galactose metabolism defect defined by early cataracts, annotated 30-79%. Neurologic and hepatic findings are occasional.
Bone mineralization disorder with recurrent fractures and skeletal deformities. Blue sclerae do not establish ocular impairment.
Neuroendocrine tumor umbrella, predominantly gastrointestinal in origin. Pulmonary origin is a minority subtype; carcinoid heart disease is not common across the group.
Leukodystrophy with cerebral white matter abnormalities, subcortical cysts and progressive neurologic dysfunction.
Granulomatous orchitis is described as an autoimmune reactive process. Testicular reproductive tissue has no axis; endocrine dysfunction is not established.
Skeletal dysplasia defined by bone fragility and reduced bone mineral density; additional organ disease is subtype-dependent.
Astrocytic tumor originating in the brain.
Congenital nail dysplasia; associated structural phalangeal abnormalities, including distal phalanx duplication, occur in 30-79%.
Reproductive system disease umbrella has no axis; endocrine disorders among its subtypes do not characterize the whole group.
Nonpsychiatric primary polydipsia is a disorder of thirst and water balance. No structural neurologic or renal damage is established.
Severe growth failure with low growth hormone annotated 30-79%; developmental delay also annotated 30-79%, although the definition calls it occasional.
Carcinoma originates in a major salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Interferonopathy with encephalopathy; thrombocytopenia in 2/5 supports blood involvement. Hepatomegaly alone lacks functional damage; hepatic steatosis occurs in 1/5.
Inherited uric acid stone disease affects the urinary tract; a systemic metabolic disorder is not established by stone composition alone.
